entries.label_en: 1. For the start and end times of each notifiable-disease dataset, see the application time-limit table. Note: This center's databases are de-identified; directly identifying fields such as name and address are removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insurer-unit code, tax ID, birth date, visit date, and admission date are masked. Data may only be used in the ministry's dedicated on-site work area, and only reviewed and approved aggregate results may be taken out, ensuring individuals cannot be re-identified. The serial number (REPORT) is the notifiable-disease report number and serves as the key linking to other notifiable-disease data files.
